title: IdentityMatrix
text: Generate matrix with ones on main diagonal and ground values elsewhere, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Mode} sets Data type mode; {Inherit output port attributes from input port} sets the option for output port to inherit attributes from input, {Output dimensions} sets the size of output matrix, {Output data type}, {Signedness}, {Scaling} sets the method for scaling fixed-point data Best, {Word length} sets the bit size of word that holds quantized, {Fraction length}, {Data type override} and {Sample time} sets the output sample period. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Inherit output port attributes from input port
params.values: Option for output port to inherit attributes from input port off (default) | on

params.name: Output dimensions
params.values: Size of output matrix 5 (default) | scalar | two-element vector

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type double (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | boolean | fixdt(1,16,0) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation |

params.name: Mode
params.values: Data type mode Inherit (default) | Built in | Fixed point | Expression

params.name: Signedness
params.values: Signedness of fixed-point data Signed (default) | Unsigned

params.name: Scaling
params.values: Method for scaling fixed-point data Best precision (default) | Binary point

params.name: Word length
params.values: Bit size of word that holds quantized integer 16 (default) | integer from 2 to 65,535

params.name: Fraction length
params.values: Fraction length for fixed-point data type 0 (default) | integer scalar

params.name: Data type override
params.values: Data type override mode Inherit (default) | Off
